purpose: Map how each canonical entity is represented across public platforms and distinguish identity nodes from research observations.

platforms.notes: Public video-distribution representation associated with MC-001.
Shared public distribution channel recorded for the AIO CODE ecosystem; entity-specific ownership must remain explicit in content metadata.

rule: The entity-specific platform registries are the source for platform representation records. This map provides the cross-entity index. A platform presence is a representation node, not proof of entity resolution by an external AI or search system.
data_integrity: Do not collapse MC-001, NUX-001 and AIO-001 into one identity. Shared channels or distribution infrastructure must retain an explicit canonical_entity_id and must not imply that Marii Cuadros and AIO CODE are the same entity.
